question.text: Which of the following is a basic technique of trade-based money laundering?

answer.text: All four: over- and under-invoicing; multiple invoicing; over- and under-shipments; and falsely described goods or services
Over- and under-invoicing of goods and services
Multiple invoicing of goods and services
Over- and under-shipments of goods and services, and falsely described goods

explanation.text: The Logic: The basic TBML techniques described in the source include: (i) over- and under-invoicing of goods and services; (ii) multiple invoicing of goods and services; (iii) over- and under-shipments of goods and services; and (iv) falsely described goods and services. These four basic techniques can be combined into more complex schemes such as the Black Market Peso Exchange. The Trap: Each distractor names one or two of the four basic techniques, which makes it tempting to pick a single category. However, the source lists all four as basic TBML techniques, so the correct answer must include all of them. Misrepresenting the quality or type of goods is as much TBML as price manipulation. Note: Sophisticated TBML schemes such as the Black Market Peso Exchange are built by stacking these four basic techniques — invoicing, multiple invoicing, shipment manipulation, and misdescription of goods.
